mapper.select: SELECT MAX(tenant_code) FROM tb_tenant WHERE tenant_code LIKE #{value} + '%' AND LEN(tenant_code) = 10 AND tenant_code NOT LIKE '%[^0-9]%'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_tenant ( tenant_code, tenant_nm, admin_email, corporate_number, business_type, business_category, onboarding_status ) VALUES ( #{tenantSerialCode}, #{tenantNm}, #{adminEmail}, #{corporateNumber}, #{businessType}, #{businessCategory}, 'EMAIL_QUEUED' )
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_tenant SET onboarding_status = #{onboardingStatus}, updated_at = GETDATE() WHERE tenant_code = #{tenantCode}
mapper.select: SELECT MAX(la.login_id) FROM tb_login_account la JOIN tb_tenant t ON t.tenant_id = la.tenant_id WHERE t.tenant_code = #{value}
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_tenant_subscription SET subscription_status = 'EXPIRED', ends_at = ISNULL(ends_at, GETDATE()), updated_at = GETDATE() WHERE tenant_id = #{value} AND subscription_status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_tenant_subscription ( tenant_id, plan_id, subscription_status, starts_at, ends_at, auto_renew, created_by, created_at, updated_at ) SELECT #{tenantId}, p.plan_id, 'ACTIVE', GETDATE(), NULL, 'Y', NULL, GETDATE(), GETDATE() FROM tb_plan p WHERE p.plan_code = #{planCode} AND p.use_at = 'Y'
mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_tenant WHERE 1=1
AND tenant_code LIKE '%' + #{searchKeyword} + '%'
AND ISNULL(admin_email, '') LIKE '%' + #{searchKeyword} + '%'
AND tenant_nm LIKE '%' + #{searchKeyword} + '%'
AND use_at = 'Y'
AND use_at = 'N'
AND ISNULL(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(onboarding_status)), ''), 'EMAIL_QUEUED') = #{onboardingStatus}
AND use_at = #{useAtOnly}

SELECT t.tenant_id, t.tenant_code, t.tenant_nm AS company_name, ISNULL( NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(u.user_nm)), ''), ISNULL(NULLIF(LEFT(ISNULL(t.admin_email, ''), CHARINDEX('@', ISNULL(t.admin_email, '') + '@') - 1), ''), '-') ) AS admin_name, ISNULL(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(t.admin_email)), ''), '-') AS admin_email, CASE WHEN t.use_at = 'Y' THEN 'ACTIVE' ELSE 'INACTIVE' END AS status, ISNULL(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(t.onboarding_status)), ''), 'EMAIL_QUEUED') AS onboarding_status, '-' AS plan_code, '-' AS plan_name, CONVERT(VARCHAR(19), t.created_at, 126) + 'Z' AS created_at, t.corporate_number, t.business_type, t.business_category FROM tb_tenant t LEFT JOIN tb_user u ON u.tenant_id = t.tenant_id AND ISNULL(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(u.email_addr)), ''), '-') = ISNULL(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(t.admin_email)), ''), '-') WHERE 1=1
AND t.tenant_code LIKE '%' + #{searchKeyword} + '%'
AND ISNULL(t.admin_email, '') LIKE '%' + #{searchKeyword} + '%'
AND t.tenant_nm LIKE '%' + #{searchKeyword} + '%'
AND t.use_at = 'Y'
AND t.use_at = 'N'
AND ISNULL(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(t.onboarding_status)), ''), 'EMAIL_QUEUED') = #{onboardingStatus}
ORDER BY t.created_at DESC OFFSET (#{pageIndex} * #{pageSize}) ROWS FETCH NEXT #{pageSize} ROWS ONLY

SELECT TOP 1 t.tenant_id, t.tenant_code, t.tenant_nm AS company_name, ISNULL( NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(u.user_nm)), ''), ISNULL(NULLIF(LEFT(ISNULL(t.admin_email, ''), CHARINDEX('@', ISNULL(t.admin_email, '') + '@') - 1), ''), '-') ) AS admin_name, ISNULL(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(t.admin_email)), ''), '-') AS admin_email, CASE WHEN t.use_at = 'Y' THEN 'ACTIVE' ELSE 'INACTIVE' END AS status, ISNULL(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(t.onboarding_status)), ''), 'EMAIL_QUEUED') AS onboarding_status, '-' AS plan_code, '-' AS plan_name, CONVERT(VARCHAR(19), t.created_at, 126) + 'Z' AS created_at, t.corporate_number, t.business_type, t.business_category FROM tb_tenant t LEFT JOIN tb_user u ON u.tenant_id = t.tenant_id AND ISNULL(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(u.email_addr)), ''), '-') = ISNULL(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(t.admin_email)), ''), '-') WHERE UPPER(t.tenant_code) = UPPER(#{value}) ORDER BY t.created_at DESC

SELECT TOP (#{limit}) tenant_code, tenant_nm AS company_name, corporate_number AS business_registration_number, ISNULL(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(admin_email)), ''), '-') AS admin_email, CONVERT(VARCHAR(19), created_at, 126) + 'Z' AS issued_at FROM tb_tenant ORDER BY created_at DESC
